---
name: Bet slip
about: Log a bet you've placed and follow it on the live tracker. Attach a screenshot or photo of the slip.
title: "Bet slip"
labels: bet-slip
---

Attach a screenshot of the placed bet (bet365 → My Bets, or any bookmaker's app), or a clear photo of a paper slip. Several images are fine for a long slip or several bets. Reply **confirm** to the reading and the bet goes on the live tracker.

This repo is public: crop out your balance, name, bet reference and any barcode before attaching. The tracker page never shows those.
